brand_faithful_inversions: Hex format retention: colour tokens are hex (matches the donor capture and the DESIGN.md Stitch frontmatter). OKLCH applies to new authoring; this is inheritance.
Pure-white retention: #ffffff kept as Chassis White for cards and inputs (donor surface). The no-pure-white reflex is inverted per brand-faithful direction; the page ground is #f1f1f1, not white.
Saturated colour retention: Power Red #961919 (channel spread 125) kept as the only action colour (donor uses it on every captured CTA). The tinted-neutral-primary reflex is inverted.

Sharp 0px corner retention (scoped): buttons, inputs and badges stay square (all captured donor buttons are 0px). Cards keep the donor 6px. The rounded-everything reflex is inverted for controls only.
Reserved colour: Status Amber #ffad00 retained only for hover/focus on navy and the active header rail (donor uses it for footer headings and link hover on dark grounds).

narrative.overview: A storefront that reads like a well-labelled server rack: everything in its slot, labelled in plain captions, and lit by small precise signals. Data Hall grey and Chassis White carry the catalog; Rack Navy bands frame the moments that orient; Datasheet blues organise; one Power Red marks every action.
keyCharacteristics: Navy bands with thin luminous blue rails (status-LED lines) instead of shadows or gradients as dividers.
Mixed-case Source Sans headings in blue; PT Sans Narrow reserved for the home display headline.
Square red action buttons; 6px chassis cards; square inputs.
Caption-style metadata labels (13px, 600, +0.04em) on badges and beside or below headings, never as eyebrows above them.
Honest empty states that always offer the next action.
Square 8px status LEDs at the right end of catalog rows (Signal Blue live, Rail Rule pending).

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Power Red appears only on things the user can do. No red headings, no red decoration, no red badges.

rules.name: The Blue Explains Rule
rules.body: Blues label, organise and link. They are never the fill of a primary action.

rules.name: The Caption Rule
rules.body: Metadata is a caption, not a sentence: one short label, 13px, set beside or below the thing it describes. Never an eyebrow above a heading.

rules.name: The Rail Rule
rules.body: Section and band edges get a 2px Signal Blue (on white) or Sky Rail (on navy) rail, never a gradient or a heavy shadow.

dos: Do keep search, cart, quick order and account reachable in the header at every width.
Do use Power Red for every primary action and nothing else.
Do put a scrim (≥ 0.55 navy) under any text set on photography.
Do label every metadata item with a caption.
Do show empty catalog, search and cart states as designed states with one clear next step.
Do reuse the storefront's own system strings ("Your cart is empty", "Start shopping", "Sign in").
donts: Don't invent products, SKUs, prices, specs, stock, ratings, totals or customer data. Don't render ADB150 or configuration keys.
Don't use the solid-plus-outline twin-CTA hero, stat trust bars, glassmorphism, gradient text or dark mode by reflex.
Don't set body text in Signal Blue or Sky Rail, or Datasheet Blue body text on the grey ground.
Don't use Rail Rule grey for input or control borders.
